analysis: Price is attempting an extension above the Value Area High at 84,400, but the move is disproportionately driven by perpetual leverage rather than spot accumulation. The strong negative spot-to-perp CVD divergence highlights significant exhaustion risk if spot buyers fail to step in and support the breakout.
key_risk: Lack of spot CVD follow-through causing a leverage long liquidation cascade back into the Value Area toward POC.
